Colenemol acts as a target for Npc162534, which in turn targets Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B1. This implies a cascade of interactions where Colenemol may influence the activity of Npc162534, thereby modulating the function of Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B1. The evidence supports a possible role for Colenemol in regulating the transporter, though the exact mechanism of action remains to be elucidated. The relationship is supported by a well-defined pathway, but further experimental validation, such as determining the IC50 or assessing the functional impact on transporter activity, would strengthen the mechanistic link.
